destinations.name: Serengeti National Park
destinations.summary: Endless plains and the Great Migration.
destinations.description: Tanzania's most famous park: huge herds, big-cat country and the Great Wildebeest Migration, which crosses the Mara River in the north from July to October and calves around Ndutu in the south from December to March.

destinations.name: Ngorongoro Crater
destinations.description: The world's largest intact caldera. A full-day game drive on the crater floor offers open grasslands, woodland and wetlands with dense wildlife.

destinations.name: Tarangire National Park
destinations.summary: Giant baobabs and big elephant herds.
destinations.description: Known for scenic baobab landscapes, large elephant herds and excellent game viewing, and an easy first stop from Arusha.

destinations.name: Lake Manyara National Park
destinations.description: A different landscape from the other Northern Circuit parks, with forest, woodland and a lake setting for game viewing.

destinations.name: Lake Eyasi
destinations.summary: Cultural visits with the Hadzabe and Datoga.
destinations.description: A soda lake region where visitors can meet the Hadzabe hunter-gatherer community and the Datoga people.

destinations.name: Oldoinyo Lengai & Lake Natron
destinations.summary: The Mountain of God and a flamingo lake.
destinations.description: An active volcano rising from the Great Rift Valley, known to the Maasai as the Mountain of God, beside the red and pink waters of Lake Natron.

destinations.name: Mikumi National Park
destinations.summary: Easy-access savanna close to Dar es Salaam.
destinations.description: Open plains and woodland that are easy to reach, including by flight from Zanzibar.

destinations.name: Nyerere National Park
destinations.summary: Boats, walks and the wild south.
destinations.description: Boat safaris, walking safaris and open bush with far fewer vehicles.

destinations.name: Ruaha National Park
destinations.summary: Rugged country and big lion prides.
destinations.description: Rugged wilderness with large lion prides, ideal for a second visit or a quieter trip.

destinations.name: Zanzibar
destinations.summary: Stone Town, white sand and spice farms.
destinations.description: End your safari with quiet white-sand beaches, the lanes of Stone Town and spice farms on the Spice Island.

destinations.name: Mount Kilimanjaro
destinations.description: Climb Africa's highest mountain on Marangu, Machame, Lemosho, Rongai, Umbwe or the Northern Circuit route.

destinations.name: Mount Meru
destinations.description: At 4,566 m in Arusha National Park, Meru offers forest, wildlife and alpine terrain, and works well as an acclimatisation trek.

destinations.name: Usambara Mountains
destinations.description: A cool, green highland region of forests, terraced farms and traditional villages around Lushoto.

reviews.name: Tal
reviews.text: We had great time. Everything was organised well, we had no worries. The communication with the office was very easy and good all along.
reviews.headline: Great experience

reviews.name: Verified traveller
reviews.text: Everything went smoothly from the very first contact through to the end of the safari. They took the time to brief me properly and ensured everything was clear.
reviews.headline: Very attentive and considerate

reviews.name: Verified traveller
reviews.text: It was a super organized trip, all that we wanted was included, we didn't have to worry about anything. They are very friendly and professional.
reviews.headline: Amazing experience, like a trip with the best friends

reviews.name: Verified traveller
reviews.text: While in Tanzania I wanted to see a bit of the country and the visit would not be complete without a safari. The whole team was helpful from start to finish.
reviews.headline: An unforgettable experience

reviews.name: Verified traveller
reviews.text: The safari exceeded our expectations. We were well taken care of at all times and the staff went above and beyond to make our trip truly unforgettable.
reviews.headline: Delivered an experience beyond our expectations

reviews.name: Verified traveller
reviews.text: Very communicative, super on time, and went above and beyond to make sure we were alright. It all felt very reliable.
reviews.headline: Welcoming and supportive, an excellent host
